dedupe_keys.name: murray darling basin weir information system

description: Murray-Darling Basin Weir Information System is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Murray-Darling Basin Authority. The Murray-Darling Basin Weir Information System brings together weir and barriers data held by New South Wales, Queensland and Victorian agencies and constructs a basin wide spatial weir information system to assist in the adoption of a strategic approach to the ongoing management of weirs. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Murray-Darling Basin Authority. Its tags are HUMAN ENVIRONMENT Structures and Facilities, Inland waters, MDBA, Murray-Darling Basin, dams. It offers 5 resource(s) in GDB, GEOJSON, KMZ, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2023-08-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
